title: Cosmic Smoke Portal
description: An abstract circular portal or void dominates the center of a dark background, framed by dense clusters of multicolored shimmering dots and particles in gold, purple, orange, and white. Delicate golden swirls and wisps of white smoke curl around the top and bottom edges of the composition.
